details:
I believe Vrchat Ready for a strict prop system.

A strict prop system?

Yes I have seen worlds and even avatars already have a prop system but unlike those this universal strict prop system will have a system where a user can put down a single item in the world of their choosing which allows props to be spawned at one prop at a time only so no spamming ever.

Lets I'm in a city map and I want a go-kart so you open the quick menu and select the go-kart in the prop inventory it will spawn in the world, and you can drive it around 

But under the strict rules, only worlds that approve/allow the prop system will allow spawning items and no spamming items.

The props must be under, I would even suggest 10k-20k polys or less and no more than 20MB to 30 MB in file size and limited complexity in features 

Besides wanting to spawn Go kart freely, I'd like to see Pool tables and spawning other games where friend can have more chances to interact with each other.

And I believe a prop system could help fund the game using the Vrchat credits with trading/copying or even help sell Vrchat plus by having a bigger inventory space for your props, a prop system can also be a positive step in innovation on the platform.

A prop system would also build a whole new market for Vrchat creators.

Because right now lets says you want a good billiards table you have to switch worlds with your friends with the prop system you no longer need to. 

I hope such a system could be considered in the future for the game, thanks for reading.
title: I belive Vrchat is ready for a strict prop system and could help sell Vrchat credits.
